newsitem.title: USA: Residents visit flood-ravaged Grand Forks homes.
newsitem.headline: Residents visit flood-ravaged Grand Forks homes.

text.p: Officials gave permission Sunday for residents to return to their homes temporarily in nearly three-quarters of flood-ravaged Grand Forks and said they may soon be able to re-open a bridge that is a key transportation link.

The welcome signs of progress, however, did not diminish the enormous clean-up task still ahead. There still was no power or drinking water in Grand Forks or neighboring East Grand Forks, Minnesota, and visits to flooded homes were restricted to daylight hours.
